children: Facility solutions provider's fiscal Q3 revenue up 4.2%, slight miss versus analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for fiscal Q3 beat analyst expectations
Company raised midpoint of full-year adjusted EPS and free cash flow outlooks
ABM raises midpoint of fiscal 2026 adjusted EPS outlook to $3.95-$4.10
Company increases full-year free cash flow outlook to about $210 mln
ABM expects full-year organic revenue growth near top end of 3%-4% range

SEGMENT GROWTH MIX - M&D and Aviation segments led revenue growth, with M&D boosted by the WGNstar acquisition, client wins, and tech market expansion, and Aviation benefiting from air travel trends and a new Heathrow contract
COST DISCIPLINE - Lower ongoing corporate costs and operational efficiencies supported higher segment operating profit and improved margins
CASH FLOW MANAGEMENT - Strong working capital management and ERP system stabilization drove significant improvement in free cash flow
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", 5 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the business support services peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for ABM Industries Inc is $52.00, about 10.5% above its September 4 closing price of $47.05
The stock recently traded at 11 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 9 three months ago
